verdict.rationale: Sentry's platforms docs say there is "a large ecosystem supported by the community" of SDKs. For unsupported use cases they point to "documentation on how to report events on your own using our SDK API", and a community report shows GlitchTip accepting Sentry SDK traffic with only a DSN change, which suggests the protocol can be implemented by third parties. However, the pack never cites the ingestion protocol spec itself (envelope/store endpoint format, auth headers), and "SDK API" may mean reporting through an SDK rather than a raw protocol. missing for 10: an explicit first-party event-ingestion protocol specification (payload/envelope schema, auth, endpoints), and independent evidence of custom clients sending events without an official SDK.
